what: First loader — on a background-color curtain, six colored shapes (heart, flower, arch, star, leaf, dot cluster) bloom around a circle in the center from 0x and transparent, one after another (at .6, .7, 1, 1.3, 1.6, 1.9s over 2s ease). The circle shrinks from 3x to 1x over 3s starting at .2s (cubic-bezier(.42,0,.36,.98)), turns two full rotations (720°) over 3.4s starting at .4s, then two more (ease) starting at 3.9s. At 3.9s the circle contracts to .4x over 1s (cubic-bezier(.42,0,.19,.98)), the shapes vanish to 0x at 4 to 4.2s, and at 5s the curtain lifts over .6s (linear). If once is given, it is skipped for anyone who has already seen it under that name

options.dur: Total length (sec), default 5.6 — shortening pulls every timing in at the same ratio
options.once: localStorage name — if given, skips from the second visit on and fires fx:done (detail.skipped) right away
options.in: Time each shape blooms in (comma-separated), default .6,.7,1,1.3,1.6,1.9
options.out: Time at which each shape disappears (comma-separated), default 4,4.05,4.1,4.15,4.2,4.2
options.out-dur: Per-shape vanish duration (comma-separated), default .8 for the first half · 1 for the second half
options.lift · fade: When the curtain starts lifting and for how long, default 5 · .6
options.radius · start: Radius of the circle where shapes sit (% of panel width) · angle of first shape (°, clockwise 0 = Right), default 47 · −124 — then evenly counterclockwise after that
options.--fx-size · --fx-size-wide: Circle panel width (via style), default 50vw · 30vw at 768px and up
options.--fx-icon: Width of one shape (% of circle panel width), default 20%
options.--fx-bg · --fx-z: Curtain color · stacking order, default background color · 1000
options.[data-fx-part=spin]: (Optional) panel that spins inside the circle, if absent, the ring spins
options.fx:done: Fires from the part element once the curtain lifts (or is skipped) — hook the body reveal and header drop-in to this

note: The original places shapes by hand with top and left in % — we placed the same hexagonal positions evenly at radius 47%, starting from −124° at 60° intervals (1~3% off the original). Body appearance (5s 1s) and header drop-in (6s .8s) are the site’s own work, so they are not included

from.where: about.html first loader (div.op-area — op-circle 3s .2s · op-circle02 1s 3.9s, op-circle-inner 720° 3.4s .4s · 3.9s ease, .icon circl-fade 2s .6~1.9s · circl-icon-scale .8~1s 4~4.2s, op-area .6s 5s linear, localStorage opAnimationPlayed)
